# Deploys Word Card Game to VPS on push to main or manual trigger.
# Connects via SSH, pulls latest code, and restarts app with Docker Compose.

name: Deploy

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: deploy-production
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Deploy over SSH
        uses: appleboy/ssh-action@v1.0.3
        with:
          host: ${{ secrets.VPS_HOST }}
          username: ${{ secrets.VPS_USER }}
          key: ${{ secrets.VPS_SSH_KEY }}
          port: ${{ secrets.VPS_PORT }}
          script: |
            cd /path/to/word-card-game # Update this path to where your app is located on the VPS
            git pull origin main
            docker compose up -d --build
